summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (formerly Galapagos) filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, attaching a press release detailing repurchases of its own ordinary shares under a buyback program announced June 9, 2026. Between July 27 and July 31, 2026, it repurchased 97,497 shares at an average price of EUR 24.48, totaling EUR 2.39 million, with prices ranging from EUR 23.68 to EUR 25.04. The company now holds 704,216 treasury shares. The repurchases were executed via an independent intermediary on Euronext venues. As an issuer buyback, this constitutes a capital return program; watch for continuation of the program and its impact on share count and EPS.
